sre-bot: :loud_sound: INCIDENT (SEV2) - us-east-1 hosted streaming paths seeing intermittent 5xx and connection resets. Early indicators point to memory pressure on a subset of streaming workers; impact ~4% of streaming requests.

nina (oncall): taking ownership. paging runtime + infra. I'm seeing node group inference-stream-2 showing OOMKilled across 4 pods. collecting pod logs and metrics.

devin (runtime): thanks. any recent changes to the compaction or eviction policy? we rolled a minor compaction tweak last night to reduce CPU.

elaine (support): support queue: multiple customers with live demo failures. Escalated to CS leads; adding temporary guidance to retry clients.

infra-bot: ```
# kubectl -n hosted get pods -l pool=inference-stream-2 -o wide
NAME                                READY   STATUS    RESTARTS
inference-stream-2-7f8b9c4d-2jzq    0/2     OOMKilled 3
inference-stream-2-7f8b9c4d-6hpf    1/2     Running   1
```

nina (oncall): heap growth graph shows steady increase in kv-cache usage starting ~01:50 UTC, compactor job failing to reclaim stale entries.

devin (runtime): rolling a temporary config change: enable aggressive eviction (ttl=5m) for stream pools and trigger manual compaction. doing canary first (1 pod).

cs-lead: notifying affected enterprise contacts. status page draft: "Investigating elevated errors in us-east-1 streaming. Engineering mitigations in progress."

status-bot: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/178314 - draft posted.

infra-bot: canary restart completed. observed memory drop and connection resets stopped on canary. snapshot: kv_cache_entries: 220k -> 18k on canary. 5xx_rate_streaming on canary: 6.1% -> 0.4%.

elaine (support): sharing update with customers: mitigation appears to reduce errors; ETA for full pool rollout 12-20m.

devin (runtime): proceeding with staged rollout 15% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%, 3m observation per phase. if we see >1.5% 5xx we pause.

nina (oncall): monitoring tail latency and connection drops. after 2 phases error rate across the pool dropped to 0.8%. continuing.

devin (runtime): patched compactor to handle re-entrancy bug that caused tombstones to remain; will push to prod after verification. also adding a safety cap on kv-cache memory usage.

infra-bot: metric summary post-rollout: us-east-1 streaming 5xx: 4.2% -> 0.6%; kv_cache_live_entries total: 540k -> 34k.

elaine (support): CS confirms most customers recovered; two enterprise customers requested immediate postmortem. logging action items.

nina (oncall): UPDATE: Mitigation complete at 2026-04-05T09:23:19Z. No ongoing customer impact. Creating RCA thread and an action tracker for follow-ups.

sre-bot: Incident update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/178314 - Mitigation successful, RCA forthcoming. :white_check_mark:
